# Saksham Dhull

> Personal website of Saksham Dhull. Writing, technical talks, and presentation slides about software and AI agents.

This index is generated from published Hugo content. Talk pages provide a short introduction and the final presentation PDF. Fetch the linked PDF for the detailed talk, rather than treating the page introduction as a transcript.

## About and contact

- [About Saksham](https://dhull442.github.io/aboutme/): Personal background and resume link.
- [Contact](https://dhull442.github.io/contact/): Email and LinkedIn.

My session at IIIT Bangalore’s Synergy tech fest: building a coding agent, from standalone Bash scripts to a production-grade software engineering agent.
- [AI Agents: Engineering Non-Deterministic Software — slides](https://dhull442.github.io/blogs/ai-agents-engineering-non-deterministic-software/slides.pdf): Final presentation PDF for the preceding talk.
